description: Simon Fraser University Electric Vehicle Parking Dataset (SFU-EVP) is a data set described in the paper "Simon Fraser University Electric Vehicle Parking Dataset (SFU-EVP)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2024), produced by Stephen Makonin, Isla Ziyat, Rylen Sampson and colleagues. Simon Fraser University (SFU) aims to make a significant contribution to the study of electric vehicle (EV) utilization and power grid management by providing a dataset [Simon Fraser University electric vehicle parking dataset (SFU-EVP)] of EV charging sessions since 2019. This dataset will be continually updated in the future. Coverage: the Simon Fraser University parking facilities in Canada. The data are held on IEEE DataPort, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support electric vehicle charging demand and grid impact studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
